front: What is the only real measure of whether training worked?
back: Whether behavior changed. Training should transform, not inform.

front: Name the three pillars of capability.
back: Mindset Mastery (steel), Skillset Enhancement (geometry), Systems Design (daily stone).

front: What are the three sciences underneath the pillars?
How do the layers of the framework stack?
back: Science → capability → delivery. Skip a layer and the system breaks.

front: How many pillars of training design are there — and how many ways programs fail?
back: Six pillars of training design; five ways programs fail; one scorecard to rate yourself.
